title: Pricing the DeFi Tail: Do Protocols or Depositors Price Operational Risk?
abstract: arXiv:2609.00911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Similar to banks, DeFi protocols expose depositors to operational risk (USD 9.45 billion across 1,075 events since 2020). Unlike banks, they are not required to hold capital against it. A protocol may maintain a buffer voluntarily. Absent one, the risk falls on the depositor, who should then demand a risk premium in the supply yield. I quantify the underlying tail on one benchmark, a per-sector Basel loss-distribution approach fitted to a new operational risk event dataset, and test both margins against it. Tails in the four core sectors are no heavier than the Moscadelli banking band $[0.85, 1.39]$. Bridge, Derivatives, and the residual Other sector exhibit cyber-loss-level tails ($\hat\xi \approx 1.6$), with point estimates past the infinite-mean boundary. The Lending tail implies a $\mathrm{VaR}_{99.9}$ capital buffer of 18% of TVL and of the ten largest Lending venues, the four holding a buffer cover on average 5% of it. Under market

translated_title: 为DeFi尾部风险定价：是协议还是存款人在为操作风险定价？
translated_abstract: 与银行类似，DeFi协议使存款人面临操作风险（自2020年以来，1,075起事件共造成94.5亿美元损失）。但与银行不同的是，DeFi协议并不被要求为此持有资本。协议可以自愿维持一个缓冲资本；若没有缓冲资本，风险便落在存款人身上，此时存款人应当在供给收益率中要求相应的风险溢价。本文在一个基准上量化了这一尾部风险——采用按行业划分的巴塞尔损失分布法，拟合一个全新的操作风险事件数据集，并分别从协议和存款人两个边际对其进行检验。结果显示，四个核心行业的尾部并不比Moscadelli的银行业区间[0.85, 1.39]更重；而跨链桥、衍生品及剩余的“其他”行业则呈现出网络攻击损失级别的尾部（ξ̂ ≈ 1.6），其点估计甚至超过了无限均值边界。借贷行业的尾部意味着99.9%置信度的VaR资本缓冲应为TVL的18%，而在十大借贷平台中，持有缓冲的四个平台平均仅覆盖该缓冲的5%。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文创新性地将巴塞尔操作风险损失分布法应用于DeFi并构建了新的操作风险事件数据集，发现借贷行业需要相当于TVL 18%的资本缓冲，但现有协议的自愿缓冲平均仅覆盖约5%，表明操作风险实际上主要由存款人承担。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers applying the Basel loss-distribution approach to DeFi operational risk with a new event dataset, showing that the Lending sector implies a VaR99.9 capital buffer of 18% of TVL, yet voluntary protocol buffers cover only about 5% on average, leaving depositors to bear the residual operational risk.
